11. If the custody officer charges a vulnerable person with an offence or takes such other action
as is appropriate when there is sufficient evidence for a prosecution this must be carried out
in the presence of the appropriate adult if they are at the police station. A copy of the written
notice embodying any charge must also be given to the appropriate adult. See paragraphs

16.1 to 16.4A

12. An intimate or strip search of a vulnerable person may take place only in the presence of the
appropriate adult of the same sex, unless the detainee specifically requests the presence of a
particular adult of the opposite sex. A strip search may take place in the absence of an
